text:
lena (people-ops): Quick flag 1 new hire Ana Rivera (starts 2026-05-04) - US citizen but born abroad, using a passport + different last name on background check. Can this trip up the I-9 or background-check match?

raj (hr-coordinator): Good question. For I-9 we only need an unexpired passport (List A) + physical verification within 3 business days. Background check matching can fail if her alias/maiden name isn't on the file. I'll reach out to candidate to confirm other names and date of birth.

emily (onboarding-ops): Checklist status:
- Checkr: Invite + identity match pending (email sent).
- Rippling: pre-hire profile completed by recruiter, direct deposit not set.
- Benefits: she opted into health + HSA. Enrollment links open Day 1.
- Orientation: I've tentatively scheduled "Welcome + Benefits" 10:30-11:30, "Security & Acceptable Use" 2:00-2:30, manager intro 3:00.
Link: https://onboarding.redwood.com/welcome/ana-rivera

dan-it: IT note: if Checkr flags name mismatch, we still provision laptop but will withhold access to prod until cleared. Also need a photo ID for building badge - we'll accept passport. I can do a 09:15 provisioning call on day 1.

lena (people-ops): Raj - can you confirm whether Checkr uses SSN + DoB for match? I want to know how sensitive it is.

raj (hr-coordinator): Checkr matching logic: SSN + DOB are primary, then name variants. If SSN/DOB match, we usually resolve name mismatches quickly. If candidate used previous last name on credit records, their consent form should include known aliases. I'll send Ana a short form to list any other names. :memo:

emily (onboarding-ops): For the I-9 verifier options: 1) in-person at Redwood office, 2) authorize a notary/authorized agent (we reimburse $25), 3) use an approved remote verification vendor (we've used I-9Remote). Which should we offer Ana?

lena (people-ops): Offer all 3 and note reimbursement. Also add a bullet about original docs only. Could we include that in the welcome email?

raj (hr-coordinator): I'll update the welcome email template: include I-9 acceptable documents, reimbursement steps, and a request to list any previous legal names. Also add a link to our privacy notice re: background checks.

payroll-bot: payroll status: TAX_FORMS_PENDING (W-4, State W-4). ACTION: candidate must complete in Rippling.

emily (onboarding-ops): I created the "Ana Rivera Day 1" calendar invite with Zoom links and the benefits packet attached. I've also added a 9:00am pre-check with IT for provisioning. If Checkr isn't cleared by EOD Fri prior to start, we'll still run orientation but limit repo access until clearance.

dan-it: FYI - if she wants to pick up laptop at local office, dropbox pickup is available, otherwise shipping ETA 2 business days. Please verify shipping address in Rippling.

lena (people-ops): Thanks team. Raj please DM me once Ana replies with alias list. Emily please follow up on Checkr if no consent within 24 hours. I'll send the updated welcome email now. Leaving thread open for updates. :handshake:
